entities.summary: Toivo Robert Tikkanen was a Finnish sport shooter who competed in the 1920 Summer Olympics and in the 1924 Summer Olympics. He was born in Rome, Italy and died in Helsinki. 1908-1911, Tikkanen played ice hockey for the Akademischer Sport Club Dresden team in Germany.
